sources.title: Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-GGUF is a local coding and agent model maintained by peculiar-ragdoll. It is a dynamically quantized GGUF build of Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, with a custom importance matrix and the Sharp chat template embedded in the file.
